 Preliminary 2.7 magnitude earthquake strikes near Pacifica 
 By NBC Bay Area staff • 
 Published 3 hours ago • 
 Updated 3 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Are you prepared for the next big one? 
 A preliminary 2.7 magnitude earthquake struck near Pacifica Wednesday evening, according to the United States Geological Survey .
 The quake hit at 5:17 p.m. and was centered 1.3 miles northeast of Pacifica, 3.2 miles west of San Bruno and 3.9 miles west-southwest of South San Francisco, the USGS said.
